data.name: Soul Ward
data.description: An intangible field of siphoned soul energy protects a ravener from destruction.  This ward has a maximum of %1 hit points, but starts at %2.  Whenever a ravener would be reduced below 1 hit point, all damage in excess of that which would reduce it to 1 hit point is instead dealt to its soul ward.  If this damage reduces the soul ward to fewer than 0 hit points, the ravener is destroyed.|TL*2|TL
